summary: The bowl changes with the city. Start with the food guide for the place you are sleeping in.
body: Hanoi’s morning is pho and the lunch is bun cha, with egg coffee when you sit down. Hue starts with bun bo Hue, then com hen. Hoi An tosses cao lầu while it is hot. Da Nang’s lunch is mì Quảng. Ho Chi Minh City’s plate is com tam, and Vung Tau’s snack is bánh khọt, one small cake at a time.
